## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for the change (a bug fix starts with a failing test)
- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- [ ] README and docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Changeset added if a user would notice (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] No new dependency, or it was agreed in an issue
- [ ] No private code, names or paths in fixtures, tests or docs
- [ ] The rules in CONTRIBUTING.md ("Rules that do not bend") still hold
